messages.text: Good afternoon. Do you ship orders to Russia?

Afternoon. No — we can't ship to Russia; our warehouses can't deliver there and it's not available at checkout.

If you have a deliverable address elsewhere (EU, UK, US), I can tell you what's buyable to it.

context.pop: Anything I can clear up before you check out?
